about: Main green v1, Part 3 — spacing and list rows, measured (no app code changed). Made by audits/consistency-v2/srboard.mjs from a harness run with CA_SR=1 (srprobe.js). Spacing covers workspace pages, the Dashboard and slide-out panels; rows cover every signed-in surface. Values are CSS px at 1512×982 and 1920×1080. `setBy` is the rule that declares the value (CDP), matched to src/**/*.css by its selector; `onGrid` means every part is a multiple of 8 (0 included). A gutter value whose two sides differ carries a `note` saying which side is not a gutter. A row's text is kept only when it is fixed interface copy; anything from the account is [data]. Crops (real size, one per distinct value or style) are in /Users/nickphysick/ScriptAlly-backups/main-green-v1/crops/.

handChecks.how: the sheet is 1424 wide, under --work-max 1660 (src/index.css:315), so the gap is --work-gutter, 32 (src/index.css:318), set by .wpg-scroll > * (src/components/shell/workspacePageGrid.css:489).
the sheet is 1832 wide; (1832 − 1660) / 2 = 86 of centring margin, plus the 32 gutter, is 118.

handChecks.result: agrees as geometry, but not a gutter
handChecks.how: on Versions (empty) the only content is one 760px card in the left column: 1424 − 32 − 760 = 632. The left side is the gutter; the value now carries a note saying so (likewise 32 332, and the carousel's negative readings on Responses).
.qcrr-row:hover, .qcrr-row.hi (qcWhoReplied.css:21); the selected row is the aria-selected keyboard highlight (QcWhoReplied.tsx:98), on the same ground as hover.

the first reading took the avatar disc's initials as secondary; the probe now reads words in order and skips initials, stars and text on its own filled ground (srprobe.js). The crop shows the name over the agency and date line.

min-height: 72px; padding: 10px 0 (src/components/agents/contact/contactV26.css:114); the rule is .cl26-row + .cl26-row { border-top } (:118), so a run's first row has none of its own and now takes its next row's (srboard.mjs).

handChecks.how: contactV26.css:124 and contactPrinciples.css:31; line heights 23.4 and 18.9 match. The first reading took the star rating as primary.
